name: prism
description: Prism (experimental, opt-in): give every project in the ZCode sidebar its own color, icon and display name, recolor conversations and automation cards, and keep the sidebar recency-ordered. The app bundle is NOT patched by default — create ~/.zcode/prism-opt-in to enable the shim; removing the marker auto-restores the original bundle.

description_i18n.en: Prism (experimental, opt-in): give every project in the ZCode sidebar its own color, icon and display name, recolor conversations and automation cards, and keep the sidebar recency-ordered. The app bundle is NOT patched by default — create ~/.zcode/prism-opt-in to enable the shim; removing the marker auto-restores the original bundle.
description_i18n.zh-CN: Prism（棱镜，实验性、需显式开启）：为 ZCode 侧边栏的每个项目赋予专属颜色、图标与显示名，支持单条对话与自动化卡片配色及最近活跃排序。默认不修改应用包——创建 ~/.zcode/prism-opt-in 标记后才安装 shim，删除标记即自动恢复原始包。

dimTitles.title: 压暗对话标题
dimTitles.description: 会话标题以 60% 不透明度显示；取色盘里的开关可临时覆盖此设置

brightenThinking.title: 调亮思考扫光
brightenThinking.description: 提升思考/流式动画在深色主题下的可见度；取色盘开关可临时覆盖

autoColor.title: 自动配色（未指定的项目）
autoColor.description: 未手动指定颜色的项目按路径哈希自动分配色相；默认关闭，只有手动指定的项目染色

groupRecency.title: 侧边栏按最近活跃排序
groupRecency.description: 对话按最后活跃时间排序、项目/分组按最新对话排序；纯显示层重排，不影响手动拖拽顺序
